issues.failure_explanation: The H^2/H^3 estimates contain terms with ||ΔΦ||_{L^4}, ||∇ΔΦ||_{L^2} and ||∇Δ̃m||. These are silently absorbed into 'C'. Φ∈X only gives ∇ΔΦ∈L^2 in time, so the Gronwall coefficient is time-dependent and C depends on ||Φ||_X and T, not only on α and ||∇Φ||_{L^∞}. Testing with Δ^2 m̃ and Δ^3 m̃ also produces boundary terms (Δm̃, ∂_nΔm̃ do not vanish on ∂Ω for Dirichlet data). These are ignored. ||Δ²m̃|| is replaced by the H^4 norm, which needs elliptic regularity that is unavailable on a polygon.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: State the constant as depending on ||Φ||_X and T, use an integrable Gronwall weight, and treat boundary terms and compatibility conditions (or assume H^4 regularity) explicitly.
issues.overall_effect: The stated a priori bound is unsupported as written; any use needing uniform-in-Φ constants (the fixed-point iteration) is unreliable.
